normative_extracts.quote: If Type(value) is Object and value has a [[Call]] internal method, then throw a DataCloneError DOMException.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: StructuredSerialize walks object graphs with a cycle-detection map, preserving Map/Set/Date/RegExp/TypedArray types while rejecting functions and DOM nodes.

production_failures.symptom: DOMException: DataCloneError crashes postMessage or structuredClone
production_failures.root_cause: Passing an object containing a method, Proxy, Error cause closure, or DOM Element into structuredClone() or worker.postMessage().
production_failures.mitigation: Strip non-cloneable fields or serialize plain DTOs before crossing worker or IndexedDB boundaries.

production_failures.symptom: Main thread freezes for 300ms when sending state to a Web Worker
production_failures.root_cause: Cloning a 50MB ArrayBuffer without a transfer list copies every byte instead of transferring ownership.
production_failures.mitigation: Pass the underlying ArrayBuffer in the transfer array: postMessage(buf, [buf]).
